author: DawnTheDuck
quote:
Reviewers lied. I was told it is a must play, game of generation but it is not.
It is called Grand Theft Auto but it is not. It feels like a Bully set in girls only school. This is not a Grand Theft Auto. It should not be like this.

I played R* games since Wild Metal Country (I doubt anyone knows about this game), and very first GTA. GTAVI is not GTA. It should be something else.

GTAVI is a chores simulator, very boring drive from A to B, from B to C and return. Buy groceries. You are forced into women power fantasy relationship. This is very boring. Very bad. Very tiresome. No freedom, no drive. I do not feel joy replaying any of this. The game has no replay value.

Performance is low. Very soapy image, tons of TAA artifacts. Frame drops.

First person mode exist but it is locked, apparently a feature to sell on the next gen.

Content locked behind pre-order and Ultimate Edition, plus GTA+ subscription.

Since what we are ok with single player game requiring monthly paid online subscription? The game is already ~100 euro for Standard Edition in Europe.

This is wrong, very wrong. It should not be like this.

If R* wanted female writing house chores simulator then why not to start a new series? Or make a spin-off? Make a Bully or something else? GTAVI is not GTA, the game literally prohibits you doing Grand Theft Auto.

This is wrong.

The only positive aspect I see is the world itself. It is kinda atmospheric. Looking forward to discover an eastern egg or two, come across some memberberries of old times when gaming was fun.
